title: Weekly reshare: Raj's Ad of the Week #1
hook: The best festive gifting ad Raj looked at this week doesn't open on the product. It opens on the person receiving it.
caption:
The best festive gifting ad Raj looked at this week doesn't open on the product. It opens on the person receiving it.

In the first Ad of the Week, our Founding AI Engineer Raj Dhakad takes one public ad apart frame by frame: where the hook really is, when the box finally opens, and why plain-text price and delivery lines earn their place.

Craft only. No guessing at anyone's results.

Worth two minutes before your next festive brief.
